The workflows are on `action_required` (fork gate) — could a maintainer press "Approve and run workflows"? Local verification so the approval isn't a leap of faith, on the current HEAD (up to date with `master`):

- `bundle exec rake spec` — full suite green (test-queue, all workers 0 failures)
- `bundle exec rake internal_investigation` — 126 files, no offenses
- `bundle exec rake documentation_syntax_check` — passes
- `bundle exec rspec spec/rubocop/cop/performance/reverse_each_spec.rb` — 24 examples, 0 failures
- `PARSER_ENGINE=parser_prism bundle exec rspec spec/rubocop/cop/performance/reverse_each_spec.rb` — green

The three new "does not register" specs (implicit method return ×2, used `if` branch) fail on `master` and pass with the change.
